responsibility: Provides rustc_infer’s inference-diagnostic subsystem, centered on the core inference error-reporting context and utilities, and organized to report type and region failures by classifying errors, tracking subtype relationships, formatting spans and explanations, and emitting targeted suggestions. Within this hierarchy, the infer diagnostics layer handles general notes, explanations, and source edits for type and lifetime mismatches; region reporting preprocesses and reports lifetime-resolution failures; and the nice-region-error components cooperate to recover the relevant anonymous, named, placeholder, `'static`, impl-trait, and trait/impl lifetime relationships, map them back to HIR types and parameters, and produce more precise lifetime diagnostics.
